English.Text: Family Circle
I was planning on visiting Fasika in our hometown, but my nephews are too busy with work to escort me…
Come, come, let us be quick about it!
Fasika! It's funny, I almost didn't recognize you because you have so many new wrinkles.
Yes, the way you've decorated is very... interesting.
And he's a farmhand, you say? Well, what a catch!
Rest, again? I used to walk farther than this on daily errands!
The lurching... (heaving) Tell it to stop!
These were once barely paths, let alone roads.
Returning already? What about the visit to cousin Haji, and aunt Tabi and...and...
Back already?
